question: After an n8n Cloud trial account exists, what does the first screen of the new instance ask (an in-app owner set-up with a name, email and password, as the user-management page for Cloud describes), and do pages 2 to 5 of the n8n-hosted onboarding survey ask for a phone number or a company name?
